lists.title: ①Tuition
subtitle:
The price will change depending on your course and the duration of your stay.
The longer you study at MLI, the bigger the discount.
link:
Q1: Can I pay the fees by credit card?
A1: Yes, you may pay your fees by credit card. However, a 4% service charge will be added.

Q2: What methods of payment can I use to pay MLI?
A2: We accept the following payment methods:
• Bank Transfer
• International Money Wire
• Cash
• Personal Check
• Credit Card
• Debit Card
• Zelle

If you would like to avoid the 4% service charge for credit/debit card payments, you may choose one of these alternatives:
Bank Transfer, International Money Wire (a $35 bank fee applies), Cash, Personal Check, or Zelle.

Q3: Can I pay my tuition after I start my program?
A3: No. Full payment must be made before or on the first day of your program.
